Full-page frames show the whole scroll height. Viewport frames (modals, popovers, canvas) show one 1440 × 900 screen.

Nebula palette

Sampled from Dialog.svg. Night navy surfaces with periwinkle text; sky, iris, orchid, pink and coin gold carry the colour.

Night#090C25App background
Deep#06081ASidebar
Navy#141838Cards (top)
Navy 2#0B0E24Cards (bottom)
Periwinkle#AAB4F0Secondary text
Mist#F5F6FCPrimary text
Sky#38BDF8Video
Iris#7C5CFFAgent, skills, focus
Orchid#E23FD6Image, selection
Pink#F256ABFavourites, alerts
Coin gold#FCC11EStory, credits
Mint#3EE0B0Success only

Signature gradients

The dialog's payment buttons and borders, reused as UI roles.

Checkout CTAPrimary buttons
Telegram violetSecondary buttons, active tabs
CryptoAccent fills
CheckmarkAnnouncement, chips, toggles, steps
SpectrumProgress, highlight borders
GuideLinks to guides
Halo ringBrand mark, hero ring
